about: Species labels for the Adopt-a-Coral 3D model archive. Keyed by Kiri model id.

fields.class: id from data/taxa.json (a species id, or a genus id when only the genus is known)
fields.confidence: 1 = determined, below 1 = provisional; an AI suggestion carries its own estimate
fields.source: human = determined by the author, ai = suggested from a thumbnail and not yet checked
fields.needsReview: true until a person has confirmed it against the 3D model
fields.at: when the label was last set

caution: Labels with source 'ai' were inferred from a single thumbnail render and are unreliable at species level, particularly among the brain corals. Treat them as a sorting aid, not a determination. Only the entries with source 'human' have been checked against the 3D model.
